## Context

This is a scoped follow-up to #1 and the implementation in draft PR #2. The source snapshot is commit `9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8`; it is not a claim that the default branch already contains that work. Coordinate the implementation baseline with PR #2 or its merged successor. Issue creation and the ready-for-agent label do not authorize provider launches, trust/permission changes, audit adoption, billing changes or new spending. Follow the execution host’s current policy and preserve existing evidence.

## Triage evidence

- Current Gemini acquisition still reports bootstrap/effective controls as unknown; the source-only hook fix did not adopt Gemini effects.
- PR #2 explicitly leaves plugin inventory and live Gemini startup/containment qualification unresolved. No new live qualification attempt was made during this triage.

**Redundancy check:** Inspected startup acquisition, effective input gates, the normal/cancellation workflow and qualification-cache binding. Existing related mechanisms do not satisfy the specific remaining contract below.

**Prior rejection check:** No rejection knowledge base or matching rejection record was present in the inspected checkout. No other follow-up issue existed at triage start.

## Dated source references

- [Provider startup/input boundary](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/provider-session.ts)
- [Native qualification workflow](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/workflow.ts)
- [Qualification evidence/reuse contract](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/src/pilot/qualification-cache.ts)
- [Scoped hook verification record](https://github.com/arduinitavares/the-council/blob/9aff16ceb97e9420ab346552c04405c38d2ffde8/docs/qualification/gemini-hook-profile-verification.md)

The agent-brief comment is the implementation contract. Parent #1 stays open until its independent operational acceptance criteria are met.

<!-- council-triage-followup:gemini_live -->

**Dependencies:** Blocked by #3. Verify those outcomes and current evidence before dependent runtime execution.

comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**State:** ready-for-agent, explicitly requested by the maintainer. This means the specification is ready; dependency or runtime gates are not implied to have passed.
**Summary:** Qualify the real Gemini startup and no-tool Council session

**Current behavior:**
The hook repair has offline coverage and a current-host 40-check helper/profile fixture. It does not supply a complete plugin inventory, an approved full startup effect set or an authentic Council Gemini normal/cancellation qualification receipt. Direct development-review AGY sessions are not Council qualification evidence.

**Desired behavior:**
After complete source inventory and permitted audit disposition, establish genuine current-scope Gemini startup, effective packet-only controls and normal/cancellation settlement through the shipped Council producer. Record exactly what is verified and preserve a specific blocker if required controls are not exposed.

**Key interfaces:**

- `ProviderRecipe` with protocol `agy-stream`, `ControlFact`, bootstrap/effective observations and the native wrapper input gate.
- `runProviderSession()`, the native normal/cancellation qualification flow, `QualificationProof`, `ContextProof` and `QualificationCache`: real evidence must bind the actual producer and current scope.

**Acceptance criteria:**

- [ ] Dependency gate: complete the Gemini inventory follow-up and validate all current audit inputs before approving a full effect set or starting dependent provider activity.
- [ ] Record exact revision, host/workspace/action, policy/control/source hashes, requested model and exposed effort/identity, permission mode, roots, ownership, allowances and finite call/deadline limits before any inference. Label hidden settings unexposed.
- [ ] Use the shipped producer and independently inspect pre-input initialization, exact agent/model/cwd/permission, actual tool metadata, startup/helper effects and required containment. Prompt text, CLI flags or an idle terminal are insufficient proof.
- [ ] Demonstrate ordinary completion and a bound cancellation under the existing probe contract, with correct zero-input accounting and positive settlement of owned provider, descendants, wrapper, timers and terminal.
- [ ] Persist and independently verify source/workspace/producer-bound receipts. Valid matching proof is reusable; foreign, expired or drifted proof is rejected. Use fresh run identifiers and deadlines and retain old journals.
- [ ] Add portable boundary regressions for observed gaps. Publish sanitized live evidence separately from fixtures, with fresh cross-family review. If required live controls remain unavailable, keep this issue and parent operational acceptance open with the exact gap.

**Out of scope:**

- Cursor qualification, billing setup and complete multi-role Council acceptance.
- Global settings/permission/trust changes, real endpoint reads, paid overflow, arbitrary tool access or silent model substitution.
- Claiming the helper-profile fixture or direct AGY review as proof of a fully contained Council session.

**Execution and delivery:**
Work against a revision containing the relevant PR #2 implementation. Recheck the current tree and host policy. Supply portable offline coverage and a reviewable change or validation record, with fresh independent review of material work. Required live evidence must use already-authorized, qualified routes and finite declared call/deadline limits. If a required external capability or permission is unavailable, retain a precise blocker and leave operational completion open; do not substitute a diagnostics-only result for the requested behavior. No global settings, accounts, historical artifacts or unrelated work may be changed under this brief.


**Dependencies:** Blocked by #3. Verify those outcomes and current evidence before dependent runtime execution.

<!-- council-agent-brief:gemini_live:v1 -->
